definitions.explanation: The act of lending something to someone; credit extended to others.
Something available for rent or hire.

examples.english: He owes me (I have a loan out to him).
examples.notes: Figurative: he owes me a favor

examples.japanese: {貸|か}し⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{借|か}りた→借りる：00532_kariru⟧。

examples.english: This book is currently on loan.

examples.english: This room is used as a rental meeting room.

notes:
{貸|か}し is the noun form of ⟦{貸|か}す→貸す：00537_kasu⟧ (to lend). It indicates lending or something for rent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {貸|か}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have a loan out; someone owes you)
- {貸|か}し⟦{借|か}り→借り：02579_kari⟧ (lending and borrowing)
- {貸|か}し⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (lending out, circulation)

COMPOUNDS:
- {貸|か}し⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧ (rental bicycle)
- {貸|か}し⟦{会議室|かいぎしつ}→会議室：01265_kaigishitsu⟧ (meeting room for rent)
- {貸|か}し⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧ (costume rental)
- ⟦{貸|か}し{切|き}り→貸し切り：08292_kashikiri⟧ (private charter, reserved)

IDIOMATIC:
- {貸|か}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to create a debt of favor)
- {貸|か}し⟦{倒|だお}れ→倒れ：noentry⟧ (bad debt)
